texts.orig: The discrepancy between the expected and the reported initial and final states may be due to large deviations, i.e., obtaining an unlikely ensemble from a collection of measurements due the finite size of the experimental record, or due to pre- and post-selection, where our assistant might have chosen a sub-ensemble of realizations to cook up some desired ˜ α i and ˜ β j probabilities. Either way, in the spirit of Schr¨ odinger's original gedanken experiment, we pose the following question: what is the most likely joint probability ˜ p ij that led to the outcomes ˜ ρ 0 and ˜ ρ 1 ? In other words, if the outcomes were postselected, what is the most likely way this post-selection was achieved?
